kai: Heads-up — canary run showed subtle token drift when using the paged FlashAttention + fused-RoPE path with KV-cache chunking. Not huge, but reproducible on long sequences >2048. :thinking:

maria: ugh. do you have a minimal repro or logs?

kai: yes, attached quick logs below. reproducer: run with --seq=4096 --kv-chunk=512 --attn=flash_paged_fused --rotary-dim=64 --rope-scale=1.0

sanjay: paste logs? sometimes boundary concat in kv-cache introduces fp accumulation if we don't re-normalize phases.

kai: logs (trimmed):
```
step=1200 seq=4096 model=vicuna-fused_attn kernel=flash_paged_fused rot_dim=64 rope_scale=1.0
ref_hash=0x8f23a1b6 out_hash=0x8f23a5d9 mismatches=23/2048
mean_abs_diff=3.2e-07 max_abs_diff=1.1e-05
```

kai: mismatch rate ~1.1% tokens different compared to unfused reference, and perplexity +0.7 on eval set. throughput ~5% lower too.

maria: ok thanks. can you try toggling scaled_rope off? in some kernels we saw numerical regression when scale != 1.0. also try float64 accumulation in the chunk concat path.

kai: tried scaled_rope=false -> mismatch drops to 0/2048 and perf same. so seems interaction between scaled RoPE path and paged flash kernel.

ashok: cc @sanjay (kernel owner). My hunch: fused-RoPE applies complex-phase math fused into QK matmul; when we do paged KV we split keys/values and later concat. If fused math assumes contiguous attention state, chunk boundaries can shift phase accumulation. Might need an explicit phase-rollover correction when building chunked KV cache.

sanjay: assigned to me. I can reproduce locally. quick debug patch: ensure rotary_phase_offset is applied per-chunk concat instead of once at init. patch in mind:
```
// before: apply_rotary(q,k,base_phase)
// after: for each chunk apply_rotary(q_chunk,k_chunk, base_phase + chunk_offset)
```

perf-bot: perf report from canary 1768004200:
- baseline (unfused): 1200 tok/s
- flash_paged_fused (current): 1140 tok/s (-5%)
- flash_paged_fused (scaled_rope off): 1155 tok/s (-3.75%)

dev-bot: CI flaky test: integration/rope_fused_chunking failed on linux-gpu-4 with seed 42. see https://ci.internal/17680

maria: interesting that disabling scaled_rope recovers correctness but changes perf a bit. we should aim for correctness-first and then optimize. potentially add feature-flag to fallback when chunking enabled.

kai: Agreed. Plan: sanjay to open PR that adds per-chunk phase offset + unit test (repro case above) and a runtime fallback flag (ROPE_FUSED_CHUNK_SAFE=false) so we can gate in canary. Also add a microbench for accumulation precision.

sanjay: will do. timeline: draft PR today, test tomorrow. linking ticket INF-8421.

ashok: also add config to console for Dedicated customers to disable fused-rope at model level for now.

kai: thanks. follow-ups: - sanjay, include perf numbers before/after + numeric tolerance thresholds - maria, add regression alert to Optimize so we get automatic detection if mismatch rate >0.1% in canary runs - assignees update INF-8421

maria: last note: check rotary_dim routing too — some models route different rotary_dim per-head and fused kernel had a bug if head_dim % rotary_dim != 0. small repro in my test harness.

sanjay: noted, will include paramized tests for head dim/rotary dim divisibility + chunking.

kai: thanks everyone. I'll schedule a 15m sync if PR is non-trivial. :thumbsup:
